description: Construction of single barrell canopy made of pressurised canvas to house three (3) padel tennis courts along with one (1) uncovered court with associated floodlighting, club hut and landscaping.
subdivision_of_building: The application does not relate to any existing buildings.
site_name: Land at Footscray Rugby Sports and Athletic Club, Footscray Road, London, SE9 2EL

open_spaces_details.description: The development comprises the delivery of a covered padel tennis facility within an existing sports club. The proposed canopy is a lightweight structure, not a "building" resulting in the loss of open space. The club hut is a modest building (24sqm) which is essential to the operation of the padel tennis facility.
open_spaces_details.open_space_type: Outdoor sports facilities incl. school playing fields
